Redraw a compact near-round head seated at the shoulders with a VERY SHORT BROAD transition, moving the actual garment collar/shoulder geometry up to meet the curved underside of the chin. Preserve the original floral garment and open V, brown curled hair, pose, photograph frame, opaque interior and note. Preserve exposed yellow upper chest where genuinely visible; do not create a cream bib, new undershirt, pinched collar or long yellow stalk. Preserve unrelated original-visible appearance and full raw resolution. No programmatic art patch.
